web-authored.840b0462024a24e6: Where does the session actually happen?
web-authored.593b16ed3f937d11: In your browser, at /session/<booking id> — you do a quick camera and mic check, then wait there until the creator joins.
web-authored.106b0609258578a1: What decides whether the creator gets paid
web-authored.937a67a187cc11a9: A note on where we are today
web-authored.1028a057e12bf7d9: Do I need an account to browse the marketplace?
web-authored.0dd60044d1f4757c: No. avatok.ai/marketplace is open to everyone, signed in or not — you only need an account when you actually book or pay.
web-authored.26362660afa2cfc0: What are the three groups on the marketplace?
web-authored.1c1e0f9c5bb4ad6a: India goes live (live streams), Find your people (one-on-one company) and Book their time (booked experts) — every live show and 1:1 listing sits in one of these three.
web-authored.abdc68bd88a3ce17: A note on what you will see
web-authored.b6b340998c778ecd: Can I message a creator directly from avatok.ai?
web-authored.e90006be86477658: No — the website does not have messaging. It shows you the creator's Saathum number and a link to open (or download) the app, where the conversation actually happens.
web-authored.59bc5969b2bd9db5: Do I see the creator's real phone number?
web-authored.abc238652f553d4b: No. Their Saathum number is a stand-in for their real number — neither of you ever sees the other's actual phone number.
web-authored.bf47e1c215163300: What you see on a listing page
web-authored.039c65b01292d54c: If a creator has not set up their number yet
web-authored.d48ce80b3217562f: Can I still join a show a few minutes after it was meant to start?
web-authored.b4114a45df0fdd5b: You can buy a ticket up to about 15 minutes after the scheduled start. If the creator hasn't gone live by then, the show is treated as a creator no-show and ticket holders are refunded.
web-authored.d56bcdc47535ccce: What if the creator never goes live?
web-authored.3f8d5c053f5982ef: You don't need to do anything — if the creator hasn't gone live about 15 minutes after the scheduled start, avaTOK cancels your ticket as a creator no-show and starts a full refund automatically.
web-authored.2f495a7cbb12ab82: If the creator never starts the show
web-authored.7c356e08d5245740: How much is one token worth?
web-authored.b0d05a18211b3f4a: 100 Tokens = $1 as avaTOK's internal accounting anchor. Checkout may be shown in local currency using a server-owned FX quote captured with the payment.
web-authored.f96a7b35af9f1cef: Can I get my unused tokens back as cash?
web-authored.487d9e08f2012478: Withdrawal semantics are not yet available. If a refund or reversal applies, avaTOK uses the exact token amount recorded for the original transaction.
web-authored.49090567968303c7: Open the listing from My listings and go to the last step of the listing wizard. The check there lists every unmet requirement in plain language, so you can fix them all in one go.
web-authored.8ad32416ab667308: Does my face photo appear on my listing?
web-authored.89e00c20a8df1fd2: No. It is only used to generate your AI poster and is never shown publicly.
web-authored.7392fe878e0a8273: Can I sell something without a schedule?
web-authored.d8d42a1cc7fe510a: Yes — marketplace listings (buy, sell, social) don't need a category, a schedule or photos to publish; live events and 1:1 sessions do.
web-authored.fbd0b727ec2879e7: What a live show or 1:1 session needs, on top of that
web-authored.85200a161afb10b6: Why do I have to test my camera, mic and speaker before joining?
web-authored.d2f8ea48457b10be: avaTOK checks your camera preview, microphone level and speaker sound before you enter a session, so you find out about a device problem before your customer is waiting on you.
web-authored.494e0c86512c3ec6: What happens if the other person doesn't join?
web-authored.9877e2d490be0748: If you connect and the buyer never shows up, the booking counts as delivered and you're paid your share. If the buyer connects and you don't, it's treated as a no-show on your side and the buyer is refunded in full.
web-authored.a2015106f135ca50: When does my live show actually end?
web-authored.b2b068fd67c9b741: It doesn't end the instant your scheduled time is up — the platform gives a short grace period after the scheduled end before the listing is marked complete, so running a little over doesn't cut you off mid-show.
web-authored.d966251c64f48a26: There's no fixed timeline published — your listing sits in the review queue until a reviewer looks at it.
web-authored.532582c5d14a254d: Can a reviewer change my listing without asking me?
web-authored.a3eaa2f91df4954b: Yes — a reviewer can edit listing content to fix a problem, and your listing keeps its approval. Every change is recorded with its before and after values.
web-authored.2d5298b455d9b7a8: My listing was approved — why can't I publish it?
web-authored.a9633938a23dea40: Approval and publishing are separate checks. A listing must still meet every publish requirement (see Create a listing) at the moment you publish it, even after review.
web-authored.ec106e4cb6497a00: If a reviewer edits your listing
web-authored.c786135f02083a0b: What currency do I set my price in?
web-authored.b44d4a6a5373df56: You set it in whole tokens. avaTOK uses 100 Tokens = $1 as an internal anchor; buyer checkout may show a server-owned local-currency quote.
web-authored.013108191e60baef: What's the lowest price I can set?
web-authored.beb471d1ea2bfb57: For live shows and 1:1 sessions, the minimum is 49 tokens per hour.
web-authored.9cf219722147192c: Can I list something for free?
web-authored.a1344742ae5ae3b2: The free-listing option exists in the wizard, but it's currently limited to test accounts — on a regular account you'll need to set a price to publish.
web-authored.20746a8ca36db884: What do I need to sign up on the website?
web-authored.7a810b87f3953c9d: Your name, an email address you can check, and an Indian mobile number (+91) — you'll verify both with a one-time code before your account opens.
web-authored.5d1364b6c745ad96: Do I get my Saathum number when I sign up on the web?
web-authored.1cf09d86320daa74: No. Web sign-up creates your account; choosing your Saathum number and the rest of onboarding happen the first time you open the avaTOK app.
web-authored.5066b0957167a105: Why does avaTOK need my real phone number if it stays private?
web-authored.55c53294b4590c12: It's used to verify you're a real person and to secure your account — everyone else only ever sees your Saathum number, never your real one.

web-authored.09c660cf17d83883: Do I need the app to watch a live show or join a session I've booked?
web-authored.b8b020405e79193a: No — you can watch and join right in your browser at avatok.ai; the app is for the full experience, including chat with the creator.
web-authored.e56eb153638f37f3: Where do I choose my Saathum number?
web-authored.e5ae409da6af2b1d: In the app. Signing up on the website only creates your account — your Saathum number and the rest of onboarding happen the first time you open the app.

web-authored.e99d220dbe28fc5d: avaTOK (avatok.ai) is a global creator marketplace for paid live streaming and paid 1:1 video sessions. Creators publish a listing, people book or join it, and the creator gets paid.
web-authored.79eb268658305134: Is avaTOK the same as avatok.tech or an avatar app called AvaTok?
web-authored.92241cd5a0ca8851: No. avaTOK at avatok.ai has no connection to avatok.tech (industrial conductors) or to any avatar-video app that shares the name — if you're looking for those, this isn't it.
